subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the security owners approve these 14 exact-SHA action upgrades as one grouped change after refreshed CI, or require the privileged action families to be split for separate review?
rationale: The branch changes third-party executable code across credential, agent, scanning, and publishing workflows, and repository policy assigns part of that surface to security owners.

options.title: Refresh and approve grouped update
options.body: Rebase or regenerate the PR, verify each upstream release range and required check, then approve the grouped exact-SHA refresh.

options.title: Split privileged action families
options.body: Separate token, Codex, Docker publishing, and CodeQL updates so each security-sensitive behavior change can be reviewed and reverted independently.

options.title: Pause the dependency refresh
options.body: Leave the existing pins in place until the Codex source gate and failing workflow results can be resolved with higher confidence.

recommendation.title: Refresh and approve grouped update
recommendation.body: Rebase or regenerate the PR, verify each upstream release range and required check, then approve the grouped exact-SHA refresh.

likelyOwner.reason: This team owns the changed security scanning and dependency-guard workflow surfaces under CODEOWNERS.
